# Data Source: tfe_hyok_encrypted_data_key

This data source can be used to retrieve a Hold Your Own Keys (HYOK) encrypted data key.

## Example Usage

```python
import constructs as constructs
import cdktf as cdktf
# Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
# See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.
import ...gen.providers.tfe as tfe
class MyConvertedCode(cdktf.TerraformStack):
    def __init__(self, scope, name):
        super().__init__(scope, name)
        tfe.data_tfe_hyok_encrypted_data_key.DataTfeHyokEncryptedDataKey(self, "tfe_hyok_encrypted_data_key1",
            id="dek-123"
        )
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the HYOK encrypted data key.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The timestamp when the key version was created.
- `customer_key_name` (String) The customer provided name of the HYOK encrypted data key.
- `encrypted_dek` (String) The encrypted data encryption key (DEK) of the HYOK encrypted data key.
